text:
Ana: Quick sync — after yesterday's serving outage we need to update the PRD and runbook with explicit autoscaling fallback guardrails. Goal: avoid cascade failures on coldstart spikes.

Sam: What's in scope? Just hosted API behavior or Dedicated too?

Ana: Both. Priority on hosted, but add notes for Dedicated restrictions (no autoscale across reserved pools). Also need acceptance criteria + rollout plan.

Jess: Suggestions for acceptance criteria:
- system returns 503 only when all fallback models exhausted
- latency p95 under 500ms for requests routed to fallback (for <= 256 tokens)
- automatic rollback if error rate > 5% over 5m

Mohit: Technical constraints: fallback model must be quantized variant; KV cache warming to be attempted before routing to fallback. Also add rate-limit backpressure knob and circuit breaker.

incidents-bot: Incident report: outage-2024-07-31 1719899000 — link https://redwood/infra/incidents/12345

Sam: I'll own the PRD edits. ETA EOW? Can we target Tuesday review with eng-runtime + SRE?

Jess: I'll add acceptance test harness + example eval prompts. Stubs:
```
curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"model":"gptx-fallback","input":"hello"}'
```

Ana: Timeline: PRD draft by Mon EOD, RFC for rollout Wed, dev + QA Thurs-Fri, canary Mon next week. @Mohit please add runbook steps and playbook snippet.

Mohit: Will add runbook; quick snippet:
- step 1: verify fallback pool health
- step 2: toggle `fallback.enable=false` in config if errors spike
- step 3: escalate to oncall if fallback fails to serve >3m

Jess: :thumbsup: adding test acceptance criteria in GH test harness issue.

Ana: Thanks team. Linking PRD template: https://redwood/docs/prd-template Please tag me in PRD update. :handshake:
